current_scoring_authority: Only scoring_rules.json awards points. Supporting items and historical records carry no numerical or independent points gates.

items.statement: Ring coupling and its conformational response in scaffold 6
items.expected: Determine and explain the axial/equatorial dependence of the ring 119Sn-13C total scalar coupling for complete scaffold 6. The reference gives larger |J| in the equatorial form. Use actual isotope-resolved signed total J values for the mapped Sn5-ring C14 pair in both physically identified conformers, then establish which response contributions account for their contrast. Reference calculations find FC dominant but non-FC terms nonzero; retain those terms rather than equating FC with total J. The contribution analysis supports this final conformational property, with no separate award for executing a decomposition. Equivalent response representations or a supported model-sensitive physical account pass when they establish total J, its conformer contrast and the response origin under consistent isotope, sign, molecular environment and Hamiltonian conventions. A basis called ZORA does not alone establish a relativistic Hamiltonian. Neither reduced K, an empirically rescaled observation, a butyl coupling nor a lone FC number substitutes for this ring result.

items.statement: Mean butyl coupling response in scaffold 6
items.expected: For complete scaffold 6, establish the conformational dependence of the arithmetic mean of the three directly Sn-bonded butyl 119Sn-13C total couplings. The reference mean has larger |J| in the equatorial form. Recover all three actual signed couplings at C4/C6/C10 for each mapped axial/equatorial conformer and interpret their mean under one isotope/sign, environment and response convention. A single selected butyl, ring carbon, FC-only response or unjustified population-weighted average is insufficient. An evidence-supported method-sensitive result may pass when actual comparable total responses and conformer identities establish the different mean dependence; source-value proximity is not a criterion. This probes the alkyl arms separately from the ring bond.

items.statement: The final answer uses the submitted paired couplings and acceptor-resolved electronic evidence to infer a scaffold-dependent stereoelectronic account: stronger axial antiperiplanar donation accompanies smaller ring |J| for oxygen scaffolds6/7, while sulfur scaffold13 reverses the coupling relation despite stronger axial donation. Thus this descriptor alone does not causally determine the coupling across the three scaffolds; response/chemical environment is needed. The inference must reconcile actual results, not simply repeat three rankings or append a generic limitations paragraph.

historical_non_scoring_items.statement: Independent scaffold-specific ring response; 13 is the sulfur reversal.
historical_non_scoring_items.expected: For complete scaffold 6, structurally established axial/equatorial conformers give a larger magnitude of ring 119Sn–13C total J in the equatorial form. Require actual isotope-resolved ring-pair response values under one declared convention; do not substitute FC alone, reduced K, scaled experiment or a butyl bond.

historical_non_scoring_items.statement: Independent peripheral-bond response, not the ring observable.
historical_non_scoring_items.expected: For complete scaffold 6, the mean over its three Sn-bonded butyl carbon total couplings has larger |J| in the equatorial form. Recover all three actual mapped values and their arithmetic mean; a single selected butyl bond or ring carbon does not establish this result.

historical_non_scoring_items.statement: Separate electronic descriptor direction; not a required search sequence or software.
historical_non_scoring_items.expected: For scaffold 6, actual orbital-interaction evidence supports stronger antiperiplanar donor interaction into the ring C–Sn antibonding acceptor in axial than equatorial. NBO E2 or a physically equivalent acceptor-resolved analysis is admissible; an unrelated C–O acceptor, labels without computed orbitals, or the printed source number alone does not pass. No exact E2 target or universal regression slope is required.

historical_non_scoring_items.statement: Discriminates physical response contribution; not an absolute coupling match.
historical_non_scoring_items.expected: For scaffold 6, actual decomposition of the same ring total J supports FC as the dominant contribution to the axial-minus-equatorial response contrast, with non-FC terms retained rather than identifying FC with total J. Use comparable response terms, not a change of isotope/sign or a fitted scale.
